==About Voicelines==
{{VO
|character                   = Lucy
|language                    = en

<!-- Thoughts -->
|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = Don't really understand the peeps here. One friendly convo makes someone a choom? One fight, and you trust 'em to watch your back? Can't imagine any of you survivin' a day in Night City.

|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = ...Askin' about my cyberware? Guess you're not sportin' a scanner. Sorry, but I ain't interested in talking about me or my specs... Rather change the subject.

|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = I fell into the edgerunner life by chance, but got the gist of crew dynamics pretty quick. Us havin' two netrunners proved a real advantage. When things got messy, I could hand off hacking duties and flank the enemy with my monowire... Adaptive and effective.

|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = Ahem... So yeah, should apologize for tryin' to hack you. If it's any comfort, I got zilch. My scans couldn't read your biodata—your identity's a total black box. Piqued my curiosity, sure, but I decided against digging. Who you are now... is someone I trust.

|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = You ever been to the Moon? I have, but it cost me a lot... Still remember exactly how I felt when I first arrived. Even though David couldn't take me, I knew we were there together.


<!-- Miscellaneous -->
|vo_02_01_title              = Lucy's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = I used to slip outside city limits on still nights to go see the stars. The peace, the silence... I could let my worries melt away, y'know? From the desert, Night City looks like a neon prison, a cage of light. And everyone's trapped inside... myself included.

|vo_02_02_title              = Lucy's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = Sleep doesn't come easily. I close my eyes, and he's there... the cyborg boogeyman. My memory of that day follows me everywhere, even to the Moon. But after what happened here, think I feel strong enough now to face it. So... thank you.

|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = Do energy drinks count? A deep dive into the Net saps you fast, in body and mind. Glug down one of those, it's a fast and efficient refuel. Got in the habit of crackin' one open after every ice bath.

|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = Hm, can't say there's anything I won't eat. 'Ganic foods in Night City are crazy overpriced, so by comparison this place has it beat in both taste and cost. No complaints here.

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = Used to dream of going to the Moon. Escape there, I thought, and I could leave everything behind. That dream came true... just not in any way I would've ever wanted.


<!-- Chat -->
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = "The David Martinez"—it's a cocktail found at a bar in Night City called The Afterlife. Vodka, ice and a splash of NiCola. It's funny... David never liked fizzy drinks... For most, that drink honors a merc legend. For me... a man my heart will never forget.

|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = Night City's a cage, yes... But as I fled my past, it kept me hidden, kept me safe. And just when I started gettin' comfortable, it was all ripped away... Right back to square one.


<!-- About Others -->
|vo_04_01_title              = About [[Rebecca]]
|vo_04_01_intimacy           = 1
|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Rebecca.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = She always saw me as a choom, as part of the crew. But in all our time together, I never once opened up to her. It wasn't until she was gone that I realized... just how much I left unsaid.
|vo_04_01_mention            = Rebecca

|vo_04_02_title              = About [[Mornye]]
|vo_04_02_intimacy           = 2
|vo_04_02_file               = {character}{language} About Mornye.ogg
|vo_04_02_tx                 = "Tragedy did not extinguish her ideals. She works tirelessly to reach the stars with her own two hands." I mean, sh*t, you can feel the weight of these records just by reading them. If I hadn't met 'er myself, I'd call it a fairy tale. No one holds onto hope that tight... I respect her for it.
|vo_04_02_mention            = Mornye

|vo_04_03_title              = About [[Lynae]]
|vo_04_03_intimacy           = 3
|vo_04_03_file               = {character}{language} About Lynae.ogg
|vo_04_03_tx                 = When my Resonance Ability awakened, I hacked Lynae. Not on purpose, but I did see the memories she'd locked away. Hard to reconcile the weight of her past with that big, bright smile. Can't say we're all that different, her and I. I'm just glad she's finally free.
|vo_04_03_mention            = Lynae

|vo_04_04_title              = About [[Lucilla]]
|vo_04_04_intimacy           = 4
|vo_04_04_file               = {character}{language} About Lucilla.ogg
|vo_04_04_tx                 = We've never crossed paths, but her rep's solid. Hear she did a lot of heavy lifting with the Somnoire situation. The approachable Madam President, former editor for the Pioneer Association... Official file reads like a press release though. Bet the real story's a helluva lot more interesting. Wouldn't mind a face-to-face, see the woman behind the curtain.
|vo_04_04_mention            = Lucilla

|vo_04_05_title              = About [[Sigrika]]
|vo_04_05_intimacy           = 5
|vo_04_05_file               = {character}{language} About Sigrika.ogg
|vo_04_05_tx                 = Sigrika is an interesting girl. Has a way of puttin' people at ease. But what gets me are the runes she uses. What are they? They seem to follow a unique operational logic... some kind of unparsed assembly language? What's the transmission method...?
|vo_04_05_mention            = Sigrika


<!-- Birthday -->
|vo_05_01_title              = Birthday Wishes
|vo_05_01_file               = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg
|vo_05_01_tx                 = When I hacked into the Second Coming of Solaris's database, I found a sealed file with your birth date. Sooo... surprise, happy birthday. Rebecca's been on my case for weeks 'bout a party. Whenever you're ready, I'll take you there.
|vo_05_01_mention            = Rebecca


<!-- Idles -->
|vo_06_01_title              = Idle: I
|vo_06_01_file               = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg
|vo_06_01_tx                 = Hm? Buried payload. Someone left a present.

|vo_06_02_title              = Idle: II
|vo_06_02_file               = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg
|vo_06_02_tx                 = Hmm... Right up my alley.

|vo_06_03_title              = Idle: III
|vo_06_03_file               = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg
|vo_06_03_tx                 = Yeah, could use a little unwind.

|vo_06_04_title              = Idle: IV
|vo_06_04_file               = {character}{language} Idle IV.ogg
|vo_06_04_tx                 = Well, well... Don't think I've ever seen a score that high.

|vo_06_05_title              = Idle: V
|vo_06_05_file               = {character}{language} Idle V.ogg
|vo_06_05_tx                 = Not bad. It's good to shake off the rust.

|vo_06_06_title              = Idle: VI
|vo_06_06_file               = {character}{language} Idle VI.ogg
|vo_06_06_tx                 = Pff... That was server lag. Doesn't count.

|vo_06_07_title              = Idle: VII
|vo_06_07_file               = {character}{language} Idle VII.ogg
|vo_06_07_tx                 = All right, a tune-up should do the trick for now.


<!-- Greetings -->
|vo_07_01_title              = Self-Introduction
|vo_07_01_file               = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg
|vo_07_01_tx                 = Lucy. When I was takin' gigs as an edgerunner, my specialty was netrunning. If this is just biz, that's all you need to know.

|vo_07_02_title              = Greeting
|vo_07_02_file               = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg
|vo_07_02_tx                 = I know... the dream had to end.


<!-- Join Team -->
|vo_08_01_title              = Join Team: I
|vo_08_01_file               = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg
|vo_08_01_tx                 = Eyes on the prize.

|vo_08_02_title              = Join Team: II
|vo_08_02_file               = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg
|vo_08_02_tx                 = Another contract?

|vo_08_03_title              = Join Team: III
|vo_08_03_file               = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg
|vo_08_03_tx                 = I don't work for free.


<!-- Ascension -->
|vo_09_01_title              = Ascension: I
|vo_09_01_ascension          = 1
|vo_09_01_file               = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg
|vo_09_01_tx                 = Not like any upgrade I've ever had, hardware or soft. It's like... my whole system's hummin'.

|vo_09_02_title              = Ascension: II
|vo_09_02_ascension          = 2
|vo_09_02_file               = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg
|vo_09_02_tx                 = Cyberware benchmarks keep climbin'... What kinda architecture's driving this?

|vo_09_03_title              = Ascension: III
|vo_09_03_ascension          = 3
|vo_09_03_file               = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg
|vo_09_03_tx                 = 'Preciate the assist... I'm startin' to get used to this.

|vo_09_04_title              = Ascension: IV
|vo_09_04_ascension          = 4
|vo_09_04_file               = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg
|vo_09_04_tx                 = Startin' to understand what's behind these upgrades. Your world sure has its perks.

|vo_09_05_title              = Ascension: V
|vo_09_05_ascension          = 5
|vo_09_05_file               = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg
|vo_09_05_tx                 = Not in the biz of owin' favors, so consider my arsenal of tech wizardry at your disposal. In other words... I got your back.
}}
